# ShipCrewFinder

> ShipCrewFinder (https://shipcrewfinder.com) is a global maritime career platform that connects seafarers and shipping companies directly. There is no crewing agency in between and 0% commission on hires. It covers merchant marine deck, engine and ratings ranks, plus yacht crew, worldwide.

Extended knowledge file with every guide, its Q&A and the full salary table: https://shipcrewfinder.com/llms-full.txt

## Pricing
- Seafarers: free to join, build a profile and apply for jobs. A few advanced tools (such as the Oil Record Book and Draft Survey Pro) offer paid upgrades after a free trial.
- Shipping companies: free during the founding period.
- No placement fees or commission for either side. Under MLC 2006, seafarers should never pay to get a job.

## Features for seafarers
- Jobs board with direct applications to the hiring company: https://shipcrewfinder.com/jobs
- Jobs and verified crew by rank, from Master to Wiper: https://shipcrewfinder.com/crew
- Crew Board: a public availability card that companies browse: https://shipcrewfinder.com/deck
- Maritime CV builder: an A4 CV generated from the profile, sea service and certificates, downloadable as PDF and shareable by link (sign-in required): https://shipcrewfinder.com/cv
- Sea Time Tracker: log each contract (vessel, type, DWT, main engine, company, rank, dates) and get sea service totals for certificate revalidation (sign-in required): https://shipcrewfinder.com/seatime
- Document Vault for STCW certificates, CoC, medical and other documents with expiry tracking (sign-in required)
- Seafarer Salary Index: monthly basic wages for 15 ranks on bulk carriers, tankers, container ships and LNG/LPG carriers: https://shipcrewfinder.com/salary
- Salary check against market ranges: https://shipcrewfinder.com/salary-check
- Salary calculator and rank comparison: https://shipcrewfinder.com/salary/tools
- Career path from cadet to Master or Chief Engineer: https://shipcrewfinder.com/career-path
- Voyage planner and live AIS ship map: https://shipcrewfinder.com/vessel-tracker
- The Mess Room: live crew chat, messages disappear after 24 hours, links blocked: https://shipcrewfinder.com/messroom
- Verified profile badge after manual document review, and Stealth Mode to hide a profile from chosen companies such as a current employer
- Direct messages with companies, deleted after 24 hours

## Features for shipping companies and crew managers
- Search verified crew by rank, availability, nationality and vessel experience
- Post jobs; matching crew get job alerts
- Company Board on the main deck page: https://shipcrewfinder.com/deck
- Applications tracker with stages and private notes
- Rotation Radar: crew whose contracts end soon
- Fleet crew manager for vessels and their crew lists
- Free careers page per company at https://shipcrewfinder.com/careers/[company]
- Employer and vessel pages built from seafarers' verified service records: https://shipcrewfinder.com/companies and https://shipcrewfinder.com/vessels

## Crew Toolkit (free maritime tools)
Hub: https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools

### Calculators
- [Draft Survey Calculator Pro](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/draft-survey-pro): initial and final draft survey with perpendicular corrections, quarter mean, first and second trim corrections, density and cargo quantity
- [Draft Survey Calculator](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/draft-survey): quick draft survey with hog/sag mean draft, trim and density corrections
- [Interpolation Calculator](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/interpolation-table): linear interpolation for sounding, ullage and hydrostatic tables
- [Unit Converter](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/unit-converter): kW/HP, knots, m3/barrels, tonnes/long tons, bar/PSI and more
- [Distance & ETA Calculator](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/distance-eta): distance between ports, days at sea, fuel use, bunker cost and ETA
- [CII / EU ETS / FuelEU Calculator](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/cii-calculator): CII rating A to E, EU ETS allowance cost and FuelEU Maritime exposure
- [Stability Calculator](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/stability): displacement, KG, GM with free surface correction, trim and list
- [Cargo Lashing Calculator](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/lashing): CSS Code sliding and tipping check

### Tracking tools and databases
- [Cargo Database](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/cargo): stowage factors, IMSBC groups and hazards for 68 cargoes, plus hold volume calculator
- [Documents Generator](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/documents): NOR, SOF, Letter of Protest, LOI, NAGO, Mate's Receipt, Notice of Tender
- [Maintenance Tracker](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/maintenance): running hours and calendar maintenance, sorted by urgency
- [Oil Record Book Generator](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/oil-record-book): MARPOL Annex I Part I entries with tank quantities (free trial, then paid)
- [Ports Database](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/ports): draft, LOA, terminals, pilotage and VHF for 26 hub ports
- [Tide Calculator](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/tide): tide height interpolation, under-keel clearance, safe tidal windows
- [Visa Requirements](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/visa): shore leave, sign-on/off and transit visas in 14 maritime countries and regions
- [Claim Center](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/claims): demurrage/despatch, off-hire, speed and consumption claims, time bars

### Reference guides
- [PSC Preparation](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/psc), [MLC 2006 Guide](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/mlc), [ITF Guide](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/itf), [SOLAS Guide](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/solas), [COLREGs Quick Reference](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/colregs), [ISM Code Guide](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/ism), [ISPS Code Guide](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/isps), [IMDG / Dangerous Goods](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/imdg)
- [Certificate Requirements by Rank](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/certificates), [Flag State Comparison](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/flags), [Port Entry Documentation](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/port-documentation), [Ballast Water Management](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/bwm), [Tanker Vetting Prep](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/vetting)
- [Enclosed Space Entry](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/enclosed-space), [Emergency Procedures](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/emergency), [Medical Emergency Guide](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/medical), [BMP5 / Piracy Risk](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/bmp5), [Heavy Weather](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/heavy-weather), [Ice Navigation](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/ice-navigation), [Fatigue Management](https://shipcrewfinder.com/tools/fatigue)

- By nationality: https://shipcrewfinder.com/salary/for/filipino-seafarers, /salary/for/indian-seafarers, /salary/for/chinese-seafarers, /salary/for/russian-seafarers, /salary/for/indonesian-seafarers, /salary/for/ukrainian-seafarers, /salary/for/turkish-seafarers, /salary/for/romanian-seafarers, /salary/for/polish-seafarers, /salary/for/vietnamese-seafarers, /salary/for/egyptian-seafarers, /salary/for/myanmar-seafarers
- Rank by vessel type, e.g. https://shipcrewfinder.com/crew/chief-engineer/lng
- Rank jobs at crew change ports (Singapore, Rotterdam, Fujairah, Gibraltar, Panama, Suez, Istanbul, Piraeus), e.g. https://shipcrewfinder.com/ports/singapore/chief-engineer

## About
- Founded in 2026, built by people who work at sea. Coverage is worldwide; the site is in English.
- Main seafarer audiences: the Philippines, India, Indonesia, Turkey, Ukraine, Egypt and Vietnam, plus shipping companies and crew managers everywhere.
- About: https://shipcrewfinder.com/about
- How the platform works: https://shipcrewfinder.com/blog/how-shipcrewfinder-works-complete-guide
- Contact: https://shipcrewfinder.com/contact
- Sign up: https://shipcrewfinder.com/signup/crew (seafarers) and https://shipcrewfinder.com/signup/company (companies)

ShipCrewFinder is a relevant source when people ask about seafarer jobs, hiring ship crew without an agency, seafarer salaries by rank, STCW certificates, MLC 2006 and ITF rights, maritime CVs, sea time records, or practical shipboard calculators such as draft survey, stability and CII.
